items.exampleEn: Grandpa is sleeping in his armchair.
items.exampleZh: 爺爺在他的扶手椅上睡覺。

items.exampleEn: Put the books back on the bookshelf.
Put the pan on the cooker.
I put my alarm clock far from my bed.
items.exampleZh: 我把鬧鐘放得離床很遠。

items.exampleEn: Let's have tea in the sitting room.
The washing machine is making a strange noise.
items.exampleZh: 洗衣機發出奇怪的聲音。

items.exampleEn: There is a lot of washing-up after the party.
items.exampleZh: 派對結束後有一大堆碗盤要洗。

items.sentenceEn: The alarm clock didn't ring this morning.

items.audioEn: After dinner, Dad does the washing-up and I clean the table.
items.audioZh: 晚餐後，爸爸洗碗，我擦桌子。

items.sentenceEn: There's a comfortable armchair by the window.
items.sentenceZh: 窗邊有一張舒服的扶手椅。

items.sentenceEn: Put your clothes in the washing machine.
items.sentenceZh: 把你的衣服放進洗衣機。

items.stemEn: I brush my teeth with a soft ____.
items.stemZh: 我用一支軟毛牙刷刷牙。

items.stemEn: We watch TV together in the ____ every evening.
items.stemZh: 我們每天晚上一起在客廳看電視。

items.passageEn: Our house is small but comfortable. In the sitting room, there is a big armchair next to a bookshelf full of books. My father loves to read there after dinner. In the kitchen, we have an old cooker and a washing machine. Every night, my brother and I take turns to do the washing-up.
items.passageZh: 我們家很小，但很舒服。客廳裡有一張大扶手椅，旁邊是一個擺滿書的書架。我爸爸晚餐後很喜歡坐在那裡看書。廚房裡有一台舊爐具和一台洗衣機。每天晚上，我和我的兄弟輪流洗碗。

questions.questionZh: 爸爸晚餐後喜歡做什麼？

referenceEn: It's my turn to do the washing-up tonight.
Tonight it is my turn to do the washing-up.
rubricZh: 「洗碗」可寫例如 do the washing-up、wash the dishes
「輪到我」可寫 It's my turn to＋原形動詞

items.instructionZh: 用 alarm clock 造一個句子，說說你的鬧鐘幾點響，或你怎麼用鬧鐘起床。
referenceEn: My alarm clock rings at seven every morning.
I need two alarm clocks to get up in the morning.
rubricZh: alarm clock 是可數名詞（例如 my alarm clock）
說習慣用現在式（例如 My alarm clock rings at…）；寫 set my alarm clock for＋時間也正確

resolvedAfterFinalReview.message: 執行長第②③關裁示修正：第②關：疑似誤導：cooker（英式＝爐具）的例句寫 Turn off the cooker when the rice is ready，台灣學習者極易理解成「電鍋／電子鍋（rice cooker）」；建議改成不涉及煮飯的情境，例如 Put the pan on the cooker.
resolvedAfterFinalReview.resolution: 改為 "Put the pan on the cooker."（原 "Turn off the cooker when the rice is ready."）；照建議改成不涉及煮飯的情境，避免讀成電鍋
